summary: Small __usercall helper (ABI lead FloatRoundControl, LEGACY) that takes a double in st0, rounds it via frndint, and when the input is already integral multiplies it by the double constant dbl_5E6C22 and rounds again. Returns the original value in st0; the intermediate arithmetic is an x87-side effect of setting/using the FPU rounding state rather than a change to the returned value.

operations.description: Round the incoming value (st0) to an integer via frndint, keeping the original in _ST6
Branch only when the rounded value _ST6 equals the original input, i.e. the input is already integral
On the integral path, multiply the value by the double constant dbl_5E6C22 and round again via frndint
Return the original value in st0

clean_pseudocode: round(result * dbl_5E6C22);          // frndint; value not returned
